root_checks: The complementary-index polynomial identity retains the repeated-node multiplicities and normalized coefficient trace.
For e_(4a)e_a^8 at N=5a+1, the trace is affine in Delta; the complete denominator is positive.
Canceling the repeated upper nodes leaves a divided difference of order 3a+1 of B_a^5/S_a^14 at nodes below c_a. Its derivative has one sign.
The binomial lower bound (25000/6561)^a/[3(5a+1)] is finite, and the reverse triangle inequality covers both parity subsequences.
The independent nonnegative-Laurent coefficient proof gives a second finite exponential bound with the same sign and support.

The old-pressure simultaneous comparison uses the SAME joint concave pressure and its derivative at all-half, not false coordinatewise monotonicity. Strictness follows from the Schur-complement Hessian along a segment into the strict branch.
scope: The local comparison counterexample lies on pair-equality boundary faces. It disproves an unweighted pointwise polynomial/subexponential comparison at fixed valence nine.
It does not disprove the trivalent source theorem or the volume conjecture. A global coupled comparison with adjacent profiles remains to be proved.
The arbitrary-valence old-pressure lemma does not control the moving additional terms.
publication_status: Preserve privately; not included as a new public theorem in the trivalent release.
